prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 52.5 °C (69% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 58.6 °C (51% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 57.0 °C (58% above healthy). Elevated hydraulic oil temperature and reduced heat dissipation across the exchanger indicate severe cooler malfunction.
Valve: small lag. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.67 s (within 1% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.47 s (2% above healthy). Hydraulic valve exhibits slight transient lag while maintaining target pressure.
Pump leakage: no leakage. Evidence: EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 757 W·min/l (98% above healthy); FS1 mean volume flow 3.43 l/min (48% below healthy). Pump delivers nominal flow rate at baseline electrical input power.
Accumulator: severely reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 56.9 bar (22% above healthy). Dampening capacity is substantially impaired, producing high-frequency pressure oscillations across the circuit.

tslm_prediction.rationale:

Elevated hydraulic oil temperature and reduced heat dissipation across the exchanger indicate severe cooler malfunction.
Valve: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 9.40 s (within 1% of healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.64 s (within 2% of healthy). Directional valve actuates cleanly with no discernible switching hesitation.

Accumulator: slightly reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 56.6 bar (21% above healthy). Slight increase in pressure oscillations indicates reduced surge dampening capacity.
